articles.title: Trump defends Russian sanctions relief, lashes out at Zelenskyy
Trump defends Russia sanctions waivers, accuses Zelenskyy of 'prolonging war'

events.summary: The US president defended sanctions relief waivers for Russia while accusing Ukrainian President Zelenskyy of not wanting to end the war. The remarks came as Zelenskyy engaged in talks with Washington envoys.
events.why: A shift in US sanctions policy and public friction between Washington and Kyiv fundamentally alters the geopolitical dynamics of the war in Ukraine.

articles.title: Kenya confirms eighth Ebola case amid widening regional outbreak
Ebola: Kenya cases rise to 8, spreads to 8th Congo province

events.summary: Kenya has confirmed its eighth Ebola case as the regional outbreak widens across the area. Health authorities reported the latest patient was likely exposed to the country's first case.
events.why: Ebola is a highly lethal pathogen whose cross-border spread poses severe regional public health and containment challenges.

articles.title: Oil facilities hit in deadly overnight attack on St Petersburg

events.summary: A deadly overnight strike on St. Petersburg killed at least one person and hit oil facilities. The attack also damaged a data centre used by Russia's equivalent of Facebook.
events.why: Strikes deep inside major Russian cities targeting critical infrastructure and tech assets represent a significant escalation in the conflict.

articles.title: Iran war live: Qatar to announce regional defence partnership

events.summary: Qatar is set to announce a regional defence partnership amid ramping conflict in Yemen. In response to rising tensions, US embassies across the Middle East issued security alerts for American citizens.
events.why: The formation of new Middle Eastern defense pacts alongside widening armed conflict significantly shifts regional security architecture.

articles.title: COP17: The world has a plan to save nature. Is it working?

events.summary: Governments are gathering in Yerevan, Armenia, for the COP17 conference to assess global biodiversity goals. The meeting follows calls from the UN Secretary-General to end the war on nature.
events.why: International biodiversity summits influence global conservation treaties, ecological policies, and environmental funding.

articles.title: Major fire at Canada military base leaves four dead, dozens injured
Canada: Fire at Alberta military Base kills four, leaves 19 in critical condition
Carney says 4 service members killed and dozens injured in fire at Alberta military base
Four people killed in ‘violent, fast-moving’ fire at Canadian military base

events.summary: A major fire at an Alberta military base in Canada left four service members dead and dozens injured. Emergency and military crews fought the flames overnight in severe conditions.
events.why: A fatal disaster at a major military installation impacts national defense personnel and prompts significant safety reviews.

articles.title: Kenya pastor accused of ordering parents to starve their children to death faces verdict

events.summary: Kenyan pastor Paul Mackenzie faces a verdict regarding 191 murder charges, nearly all involving children. He is accused of ordering parents to starve their children to death.
events.why: This marks a critical legal reckoning for one of the deadliest cult-related mass murder cases in recent history.

articles.title: Flour sacks turned flood barriers: Gaza faces another winter without safe shelter

events.summary: Residents in the Gaza Strip are preparing for another winter of cold, rain, and potential flooding while living in tattered tents and damaged buildings. Many families struggle to survive without adequate shelter amid widespread war damage.
events.why: It highlights the acute, ongoing humanitarian crisis and severe living conditions facing displaced populations in Gaza.

articles.title: France’s Macron declines minister’s resignation after violent protests
Emmanuel Macron slams 'failures' over protest unrest in France but refuses his interior minister's resignation
Macron refuses minister’s resignation after huge protests rock France – Europe live

events.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron refused the resignation of Interior Minister Laurent Nunez following weekend protest unrest. Nunez acknowledged that police lost control during the demonstrations.
events.why: Executive rejection of a key minister's resignation amid acknowledged law enforcement failures signals high political instability in France.

articles.title: M 5.7 - 48 km WNW of Khuzdar, Pakistan

events.summary: A magnitude 5.7 earthquake struck at a depth of 10.00 km approximately 48 km west-northwest of Khuzdar, Pakistan. The event triggered a Yellow PAGER alert with a maximum ShakeMap intensity of VII.
events.why: Moderate-to-strong shallow earthquakes pose immediate threats to infrastructure and civilian safety in populated areas.

articles.title: US President Donald Trump endorses Netanyahu for Israeli election
Israel: Trump endorses Netanyahu ahead of elections
Trump endorses embattled Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for reelection

events.summary: United States President Donald Trump has officially endorsed Benjamin Netanyahu ahead of the Israeli election.
events.why: A direct endorsement from a US president impacts Israeli domestic politics and bilateral foreign policy dynamics.
